thought.text: Saya lihat dulu OpenHands-mu dikonfigurasi lewat mana — GUI atau file.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && echo "=== isi ~/.openhands ==="; find ~/.openhands -maxdepth 2 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo; echo "=== cache/profiles ==="; ls -la ~/.openhands/cache ~/.openhands/profiles 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "=== cari settings/config OpenHands ==="; find / -maxdepth 6 \( -name "settings.json" -o -name "config.toml" -o -name "*.oh-config*" \) 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "openhands|agent" | head

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && echo \"=== isi ~/.openhands ===\"; find ~/.openhands -maxdepth 2 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo; echo \"=== cache/profiles ===\"; ls -la ~/.openhands/cache ~/.openhands/profiles 2>/dev/null; echo; echo \"=== cari settings/config OpenHands ===\"; find / -maxdepth 6 \\( -name \"settings.json\" -o -name \"config.toml\" -o -name \"*.oh-config*\" \\) 2>/dev/null | grep -iE \"openhands|agent\" | head", "summary": "Locate OpenHands configuration files", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 120}
